answer: Locks are written down in oasis, expire in cedar, and harbor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 140 aliases hence needs 112 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1911 identities would post 4243 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
